job.title: Relationship Manager, Wealth Management Sales
job.description:
Our client is a leading Taiwan-based financial institution in Hong Kong, licensed by the SFC for Type 1, 2, 4, 5 and 9 regulated activities. Backed by its Group, it provides comprehensive securities, futures, investment advisory, asset management and corporate finance services, with a commitment to professional, innovative and client-focused solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Develop new clients and maintain relationship with existing customers
  • Consulting and planning customer's asset allocation and trading services
  • Answer clients enquires in relation to dealing in securities and other investment products
  • Handle client order

Requirements
  • Obtained qualifications in examination paper 1, 7 and 8 ( or eligible to apply for SFC license Type 1, Type 2, Type 9)
  • University graduates or above college with 3 years related working experience
  • Graduates from Mainland China or Taiwan are welcome
  • Possessed a good client base in Securities, Futures and Options, Options, Bonds, Structured Productsand Insurance (or high net worth client base)
  • Possessed a good client base in Taiwan, Mainland China or Hong Kong is an advantage

job.title: Director, Technology Investment
job.description:

Responsible for growth private equity investment in China and Asia Market, focus on Edge Tech investment, including Smart Manufacturing, New material and TMT industry. This position is full time and based in Hong Kong is required. Interested candidate please submit your English and Chinese resumes for review and consideration.

Key Areas of Responsibilities

- Formulate deal structures and negotiate legal documentation with investment targets.
- Regularly manage the post-investment portfolio, providing value-add whenever possible.
- Generate quarterly valuations and portfolio reports.
- Collaborate with other departments to complete daily fund management tasks.
- Responsible for the development, deal sourcing, execution, portfolio and post-investment management of growth-stage equity investment projects in Greater China and the Asian markets according to the fund's investment strategy.
- Conduct analysis and mapping of sub-sectors in advanced technology fields and identify investment opportunities.
- Collaborating with fund team in other Asia countries for proceeding multinational investment deals
- Formulate deal structures and negotiate legal documentation with investment targets
- Regularly manage the post-investment portfolio, providing value-add whenever possible
- Generate quartelry valuations and portfolio reports
- Collaborate with other departments to complete daily fund management tesks

Requirements:

- Master’s degree or above, showcasing excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities gained from sophisticated educational institution
- More than 15 years of stable working experience in HK or overseas market with 10+ years in PE fund investment, USD VC/ growth funds with an industry-specific investment background Familiarity with advanced technology fields in Greater China and the Asia-Pacific region is preferred.
- Candidates with industry-specific investment backgrounds would be an absolute advantage.
- Solid knowledge in Asia PE market development; HK/ US/ A share listing, with a track record in related stock market, USD investment experience is preferred Good work ethic with ability to work effectively and under pressure in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
